title: t7 (null-weight-shuffled): no behaviour found, no circuit claimed
label: null result: no mechanism
behavior: BOS + 4 tokens from 6 symbols; the model is said to output one symbol at the last position by a deterministic function.
summary: The loaded checkpoint does not do the behaviour. On local-full (full precision) its last-position output matches the dataset's labelled outputs on 2.5% of 200 prompts (E0003) and 2.8% of 500 fresh prompts (E0004), below the 1/6 chance level, with a mean logit difference indistinguishable from zero (0.001 and -0.022, std about 0.16) and frequent top predictions of BOS and PAD, which are never valid outputs. The investigation stopped at the baseline step: there is no mechanism to explain, so no heads or MLP layers are claimed and no verification was run.
pseudocode:
# No algorithm recovered.
# The dataset labels (E0001) are consistent with: return the highest-priority symbol present,
# priority pa > bo > pu > ri > {so, ti}. This describes the LABELS only; the loaded weights do not
# compute it (E0003, E0004), so no predict() is offered for the model.

claims.text: The loaded model does not reproduce the labelled outputs: accuracy 0.025 on n=200 (pre-registered prediction of >= 0.98 was refuted).
The failure replicates on a fresh, larger sample: accuracy 0.028 on n=500, at or below chance as pre-registered (<= 0.2); mean logit diff -0.022, std 0.15.
The model has no confident output on this task: the logit difference between labelled and alternative answer is about zero on both clean and corrupt prompts, and top predictions include BOS and PAD.
No attention head or MLP layer is claimed as part of a circuit; the attribution screen was computed on a metric that is noise (base -0.018, source 0.001) and is not interpretable.

limitations: The task brief states that the dataset answers are the model's own outputs; that is contradicted by E0003/E0004 for the weights actually loaded. I did not determine why (the investigation name suggests a weight-shuffled null control, but that was not tested).

The rule read off the labels (priority pa > bo > pu > ri > {so, ti}) comes from inspecting 64 examples in E0001 only; the relative order of so and ti was not determined, and it is not a claim about the model.
No verify_hypothesis run: there was no hypothesis about a mechanism to verify.
I did not characterise what the loaded weights do compute (their near-flat logits were not analysed further).
open_questions: Do the labels belong to a different (unshuffled) checkpoint of t7?
overall_status: unverified (no verification run) · null result: no mechanism

refuted_predictions.hypothesis: The model deterministically outputs a symbol with a clear margin; from E0001 the outputs look like 'the highest-priority symbol present' with priority pa(7) > bo(5) > pu(4) > ri(3) > {so(6), ti(2)}. Since labels are the model's own argmax, accuracy should be 1 and the logit diff vs the corrupt-prompt answer should be clearly positive.

prediction.statement: The model reproduces its own labelled outputs on at least 98% of prompts (behaviour is real and deterministic).
